changelog: New music. The main menu, regular battles, elite battles and boss fights each have a new, fully produced orchestral track, replacing the old score. Each song plays its opening once, then loops cleanly. A new player's first launch now goes straight into a short opening battle on a small field, with the ground already mapped and a plain win-by-fighting objective. The menu and map come after it. The first battle's tips are fewer and shorter, sit under the top bar instead of over the cards, and a Skip tips button turns them off. End Turn no longer stops on a tip. Enemy damage forecasts on your units are drawn as dashed outlines, so they read as warnings, not damage already taken. In the demo, the full game's other commanders and features are shown on the menu, locked.
